chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

I asked Al-Reza (peace be upon him) about a man who has relatives, clients, and followers who love the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), but they do not know the Master of this Command (the Imam). Should they be given from the Zakat? He (peace be upon him) said: No.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: The Master of this Command (the current Imam)

ai.seo_question: Are relatives eligible for Zakat if they do not recognize the current Imam?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Reza (peace be upon him) clarified that mere affection for Imam Ali (peace be upon him) is insufficient for Zakat eligibility if one lacks recognition of the current Imam's authority, emphasizing the theological necessity of *Wilayah* in charitable distribution. This ruling distinguishes between general piety and the specific Shia criterion of acknowledging the Imamate, ensuring Zakat reinforces the spiritual and political unity of the community under the designated Imam.
